item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Fri Sep 25, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

item.title: Evening Compline — Mon Sep 28, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster

item.title: Bridges & Brunch with Strasburg Scooter Tours — Fri Sep 25 — Strasburg Scooter Tours
item.description:
Experience a relaxing morning ride through the back roads of Amish Country in Lancaster County, PA. Along the way to a 19th century covered bridge, enjoy the scenery of rolling hills, breathtaking views, and our Amish neighbors going about their daily routines. Itinerary Duration: 1.5-2 hours Some of our past tours have included:
A guided tour of one of Lancaster County’s most beautiful covered bridges An opportunity for a close up of daily life in Amish Country $10 dining voucher to one of two of Strasburg’s favorites brunch spots, Casey Jones’ Restaurant and Speckled Hen*
And each trip is unique, so you never know what we might have in store for you! *Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that some of the food offerings on the tour may not be considered ‘Kosher.’ We apologize for any inconvenience.
Source: Discover Lancaster

item.title: The Glass Menagerie — Fri Sep 25, 7:00 PM — The Trust Performing Arts Center
item.description:
Tennessee Williams’ 1944 play tells the story of Amanda Wingfield, who lives in a dingy St. Louis apartment with her son, Tom, and handicapped daughter, Laura. Focused on their future but shattered by abandonment, Amanda collides with her children’s dreams, as Tom feels trapped and Laura struggles. When Tom’s friend visits, the thread that connects dignity and desperation is pulled taut. Premiered 80-plus years ago, “The Glass Menagerie” returned to Broadway seven times.
Buy Tickets
Source: Fig Lancaster

item.description:
Vespers, Sunday evenings at 5:00 PM | In person only A contemplative candlelit service to nurture mind, body and spirit Join us for Vespers, a warm and inviting weekly gathering in the serene surroundings of the Saint James Chapel. This quiet, reflective service embraces the rich prayer traditions of Christianity and the embodied practices that nurture our spiritual lives today. Engage in uplifting singing, find solace in moments of silence, and choose the posture that feels most comfortable for you as we open our hearts to listen for God’s voice. We have meditation cushions, yoga mats, and chairs available for your comfort. We’ll celebrate Holy Communion on the third Sunday of the month. We can’t wait to see you there! In person only. Everyone is welcome—come as you are!

item.title: Evening Compline — Sun Sep 27, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster

item.title: Dillsburg Game Night - Calvary Methodist Church in the Family Center — Wed Sep 30, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Central PA Game Club Dillsburg Game Night meets every Wednesday from 6:30-9:30pm for casual tabletop games. We’ve been going strong since 2016, and most Wednesdays you’ll find about 30-40 gamers who love to learn and teach new games. It’s a great group of friendly people.
Given the timeframe, most of the games played are light to medium Euros, although many of us also love card games (including trick-taking games) and party games. We have a library of about 200 games available to play, and people typically bring their own games as well.
We also run long game days (typically every other month, usually a Saturday 2-9pm) and other special events. Join us on Facebook or Discord for more information about those.
Attendees do not often RSVP on Meetup. It may show 1 person is coming but we have 40 people every Wednesday and will cancel the event if it is not happening. Feel free to message with questions.
Cost: Free Who: All Ages (15 and under must be accompanied by an adult) When: Every
